units.source_text: “后来有一时，我久不到她家去。

en.t: Later, for a time, I did not go to her house for a long while.

units.source_text: 有一天我顺便又去访问，一看，变了样子：

en.t: One day I happened to call on her again, and at a glance I saw that things had changed:

units.source_text: 不像从前那样让我进内室去畅谈，

en.t: she no longer let me enter the inner room and talk freely as before,

units.source_text: 而且设了帷屏，教我在外面对晤。

en.t: and she had put up a curtain screen and made me meet her from outside it.

units.source_text: 我心中很不舒服，猜量她是为我久疏而生气，

en.t: I felt very uneasy and guessed that she was angry because I had neglected her for so long,

units.source_text: 觉得有些可恶。

en.t: and I thought it rather vexing.

units.source_text: 又想：既然如此，乘此机会一刀两断吧。

en.t: Then I thought: if that is how it is, I may as well take this chance to break things off completely.

units.source_text: 可是不然，这个贤女决不轻易露出醋意，

en.t: But that was not so; this wise woman would never lightly show jealousy,

units.source_text: 她通情达理，并不恨我。

en.t: for she was sensible and understanding, and did not resent me.

units.source_text: 但闻她高声说道：‘妾身近患重感冒，

en.t: I only heard her say in a loud voice, 'I have recently suffered from a severe cold,

units.source_text: 曾服极热的草药[\[20\]](#part1331.html#m20)，

en.t: and have taken very heating herbal medicine[\[20\]](#part1331.html#m20),

units.source_text: 身有恶臭，不便与君接近。

en.t: so my body has a foul odor, and it would not be proper for me to come near you.

units.source_text: 虽然隔着帷屏，倘有要我做的杂事，

en.t: Though we are separated by the curtain screen, if there is any errand you want me to do,

units.source_text: 尽请吩咐。’

en.t: please give me your orders freely.'

units.source_text: 口气非常温和诚恳。

en.t: Her tone was extremely gentle and sincere.

units.source_text: 我没有什么话回答，只说了一声‘知道了’，

en.t: I had nothing to say in reply, and only said, 'I understand,'

units.source_text: 便想退出。

en.t: then thought to withdraw.

units.source_text: 大概这女子觉得太简慢了吧，

en.t: Perhaps the woman felt that this was far too curt,

units.source_text: 又高声说：‘改天妾身上这恶臭消尽之后，

en.t: for she again said in a loud voice, 'On another day, after this foul odor on my body has completely faded,

units.source_text: 请君再来。’

en.t: please come again.'

units.source_text: 我想：不回答呢，对她不起；

en.t: I thought: if I do not answer, I will be unfair to her;

units.source_text: 暂时逗留一下呢，又忍不住，

en.t: but if I stay even for a short while, I cannot endure it,

units.source_text: 因为那股恶臭浓重地飘过来，实在难当。

en.t: because that foul odor was drifting over so heavily that it was truly unbearable.

units.source_text: 我匆匆地念了两句诗：

en.t: I hurriedly recited two lines of verse:
